youtube.script: What happens when AI finds bugs faster than you can fix them? Microsoft engineers recently faced a 'mad dash' to patch 90 critical vulnerabilities in a single month because their AI discovery tool was faster than their human patching capacity. If you are a freelancer or solo operator, you must establish automated triage queues and prioritize high-risk findings first. Automation must include human review loops before findings trigger active operational alerts. Stop trying to automate the final approval. Build the harness first.
